title: Animated dialogue portraits: Mio and Kuro, two ways
question: Do animated portraits like these belong in the game, and which way of making them?

media.caption: The moving pictures are in the live viewer (link below): the dialogue stage at its real size, desktop or phone, the still the game shows today beside each attempt. These sheets are stills from it. Video route: the skeleton driver over Mio's picture, frames 0, 20, 34 (blink), 40, 60. One slow breath, a head tilt under a degree, one blink; the picture is the first and the last frame.
The same driver over Kuro's picture.
Puppet route, Mio's blink drawing: 4 inpaints of the eye areas only (glasses frame kept), recipe recipes/blink-mio.json, seeds 1-4, #2675-#2678. s1 kept.

Kuro's blink drawing: pass 1 (recipes/blink-kuro.json, denoise 0.75, #2680-#2683) left her eyes open; pass 2 changed denoise to 0.9 (recipes/blink-kuro-2.json, #2688-#2691), s2 kept. #2688 drew hair over her eye and is left off this sheet.

options.label: mio-vm1 (video)
options.note: KEPT: best of Mio's two videos: she breathes, blinks at frame 36 and her hair moves; faults: her eyes half close and look down around frame 16, line widths and iris shapes flicker frame to frame, colours drift from the still (frame 0 differs by 6/255 on average), the straight loop pops at the loop point (4.4x a normal step); the ping-pong loop has no pop. Settings: baseline: Mio's neutral source render at game size (padded to 608x768), driver v1 (breath 4 px, head tilt 0.8 deg lagging, blink at frame 34), the picture as frame 0 and frame 80 (mask 0) and as reference, 81 frames at 16 fps, 6 steps (3 high + 3 low), shift 5, cfg 1, seed 1. Wan 2.2 Fun VACE fp8 + lightx2v, 608x768, 81 frames at 16 fps, 6 steps, shift 5, cfg 1, seed 1, 405 s on the GPU. Loop check: loop point 4.41x a normal frame step; frame 0 against the still 6.0963/255. Recipe: art/candidates/portraits/animated-portraits-1/vace/attempts.json (vm1).

options.label: mio-vm2 (video)
options.note: REJECTED: her head dips and her eyes look down from frame 24, extra blinks at 36 and 60, frame 0 further from the still (9.4/255). Settings: from vm1: seed 2 (vm1 half-closed her eyes around frame 16 and drew an extra blink; is that the seed?). Wan 2.2 Fun VACE fp8 + lightx2v, 608x768, 81 frames at 16 fps, 6 steps, shift 5, cfg 1, seed 2, 414 s on the GPU. Loop check: loop point 4.42x a normal frame step; frame 0 against the still 9.4496/255. Recipe: art/candidates/portraits/animated-portraits-1/vace/attempts.json (vm2).

options.label: mio-pm1 (puppet)
options.note: KEPT: the picture's own pixels, so face, glasses and hoodie stay exactly as approved (imgqa face drift 0.001, glasses cover 1.00). Breathing 3 px, head tilt 0.6 deg riding it, four hair regions swaying after the head, blink drawing blink-mio #2675 for 0.17 s at 2.1 s and 6.3 s, 9 s loop drawn on twos. Limits: nothing turns in depth, the mouth never moves. Rig: art/candidates/portraits/animated-portraits-1/rig/mio/rig.json; blink recipe art/candidates/portraits/animated-portraits-1/recipes/blink-mio.json, seed 1. Loop point 0.65x a normal step (no pop).

options.label: kuro-vk1 (video)
options.note: REJECTED: the background turns mid grey with a vignette from frame 1 and her colours darken a little; the red outline is stronger (12-14% against 9.3% in the still); the long side lock thins around frame 48; the pinned last frame comes out with closed eyes; loop pops 2.8x. Settings: baseline: Kuro's neutral source render scaled to 538x896 (padded to 544x896), driver v1 (breath 4 px, head tilt 0.8 deg lagging, blink at frame 34), the picture as frame 0 and frame 80 (mask 0) and as reference, 81 frames at 16 fps, 6 steps (3 high + 3 low), shift 5, cfg 1, seed 1. Wan 2.2 Fun VACE fp8 + lightx2v, 544x896, 81 frames at 16 fps, 6 steps, shift 5, cfg 1, seed 1, 443 s on the GPU. Loop check: loop point 2.83x a normal frame step; frame 0 against the still 7.3817/255. Recipe: art/candidates/portraits/animated-portraits-1/vace/attempts.json (vk1).

options.label: kuro-vk2 (video)
options.note: KEPT: best of Kuro's three, but the background words changed nothing: same faults as vk1 (side lock shortens around frame 48, red outline 11-16%, loop pops 3.1x). Settings: from vk1: the background words match her picture, 'plain pale grey-green background' for 'plain light grey background' (vk1 turned the background mid grey with a vignette from frame 1, and her colours darkened with it). Wan 2.2 Fun VACE fp8 + lightx2v, 544x896, 81 frames at 16 fps, 6 steps, shift 5, cfg 1, seed 1, 436 s on the GPU. Loop check: loop point 3.09x a normal frame step; frame 0 against the still 7.4618/255. Recipe: art/candidates/portraits/animated-portraits-1/vace/attempts.json (vk2).

options.label: kuro-vk3 (video)
options.note: REJECTED: the background stays flat grey now, but the cut-out leaves a grey haze by her side lock and collar in every frame (the grey input is too close to her shading). Settings: from vk1 (vk2's background words changed nothing): the input picture is her game cut-out on flat mid grey (128) instead of her source render's pale grey-green, since the model turned the background mid grey with a vignette in vk1 and vk2. Wan 2.2 Fun VACE fp8 + lightx2v, 544x896, 81 frames at 16 fps, 6 steps, shift 5, cfg 1, seed 1, 428 s on the GPU. Loop check: loop point 4.91x a normal frame step; frame 0 against the still 9.5252/255. Recipe: art/candidates/portraits/animated-portraits-1/vace/attempts.json (vk3).

options.label: kuro-pk1 (puppet)
options.note: KEPT: the picture's own pixels (imgqa face drift 0.001-0.002; red rim 9.4%, the approved picture itself measures 9.3%). Breathing 3.4 px, head tilt 0.6 deg, her long side lock, the bun's ends and the strands by her neck sway after the head, blink drawing blink-kuro-2 #2689 for 0.17 s at 2.1 s and 6.3 s, 9 s loop on twos. Shown mirrored on the right, as the game does. Rig: art/candidates/portraits/animated-portraits-1/rig/kuro/rig.json; blink recipe art/candidates/portraits/animated-portraits-1/recipes/blink-kuro-2.json, seed 2. Loop point 0.66x a normal step.

links.label: Live viewer: the loops in the dialogue frame, desktop and phone, with a straight or ping-pong video loop and the puppet on twos or smooth

decision: no these dont work, the video options have a whole lot of flickering and poor cutouts, you cant iterate away from that. The puppet is too slow moving and blinking is unnatural with very short frames for it.
